title: bromus incanus
intro: Bromus incanus, commonly known as the frost brome or frost brome grass, is a type of perennial grass native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and supporting digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Bromus incanus include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. These constituents also contribute to the plant's potential in treating various health conditions, including cancer, cardiovascular disease, and neurodegenerative disorders.
